name: Quick Sort
description:
Implement Quick Sort in-place using partitioning (Lomuto or Hoare).

Quick Sort selects a 'pivot' element from the array and partitions the other elements into two sub-arrays, according to whether they are less than or greater than the pivot. The sub-arrays are then sorted recursively.

complexity.time: O(N log N) average, O(N^2) worst case

hints: Write a recursive helper `quickSort(arr, low, high)`. Base case: when low >= high, return.
Partition logic: pick arr[high] as pivot. Maintain pointer `i = low`. For j from low to high-1, if arr[j] < pivot, swap arr[i] with arr[j] and increment i.
Finally swap arr[i] with arr[high] so the pivot is in its correct sorted position. Recursively call quickSort on (low, i-1) and (i+1, high).
